models.name: ACE-Step 1.5
models.summary: Full songs with vocals or instrumentals, from 10 seconds to 10 minutes. Fast, and runs on graphics cards with 4 GB of memory or more. Supports covers, editing and artist profiles.
models.languages: More than 50, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French and German.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: The MIT license allows commercial use. The authors ask that you check your songs are original, say that AI was involved, and get permission before imitating protected styles or voices.

components.name: Main model: music generator, audio decoder and text encoder
Song planner, small (0.6B). Improves song structure. Used on graphics cards with 6 to 12 GB.
Song planner, large (1.7B). Better song structure. Used on graphics cards with 12 GB or more.

training.notes: Training uses ACE-Step's trainer (Side-Step). It needs bfloat16 support, which NVIDIA RTX 30 series and newer cards have.

models.name: HeartMuLa 3B
models.summary: Songs with vocals from lyrics and style tags, with strong control over the lyrics. Up to 4 minutes. Close to real time on a large graphics card; on a 6 GB card, about 28 minutes for a 2-minute song.
models.languages: Most languages, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish.

components.name: Main model, audio codec and tokenizer

models.name: YuE2 3B
models.summary: Songs with vocals that first writes the melody and chords as a score, then performs it. Covers follow a written score of the melody, so the original recording never reaches the model.
models.languages: English and Chinese are strongest; others vary.

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0, with extra permission for individual creators
license.notes: Individual creators may publish and sell songs they make with YuE2. Companies may not use it commercially without a separate license. Crediting YuE2 is encouraged.

models.name: MuLaCover
models.summary: Covers only. Sings the original melody in a new voice and style, from a lead sheet of the melody and chords that MCF makes from its analysis, so the original recording never reaches the model. Chooses its own tempo. Up to 5 minutes; on a 6 GB card, about 16 minutes for a 4-minute song. Songs it makes may only be used noncommercially.
models.languages: Most languages, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish.

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0, with extra terms for songs made with it
license.notes: Songs made with MuLaCover may only be used noncommercially: selling or monetising them needs a written license from MuLa Labs. Credit it as "MuLaCover by MuLa Labs".

components.name: Main model, audio codec and style encoder

models.name: MiniMax Music 3
models.summary: Complete songs up to 5 minutes with vocals, arrangement and production, from a detailed description. The largest model: about 28 GB.
models.languages: English and Chinese are strongest; others vary.

license.name: MiniMax-Music3 Community License
license.notes: Commercial use is allowed. A commercial product using it must show the name MiniMax-Music3, and companies earning over 20 million US dollars a year need MiniMax's written permission. You must not use it to infringe anyone's rights.

components.name: Language model, music transformer, decoder and vocoder

cover_tools.name: Cover analysis tools
cover_tools.summary: Separates the vocals from a song, and transcribes its lyrics. Needed for covers with any model. Uses the ACE-Step AI software, which is installed too if it isn't already.

components.name: Whisper large-v3 turbo, for transcribing lyrics
Hybrid Demucs, for separating vocals from instruments

license.name: MIT
license.notes: The code and weights are MIT licensed. The model was trained on MUSDB-HQ, a dataset licensed for non-commercial research. MCF uses it only to analyse songs, and deletes the separated audio afterwards.
